GraceDeployment.Target: A local Go executable built from ./cmd/cli, running in an interactive terminal with a writable operating-system user configuration directory.
GraceDeployment.Notes: Deployment applies to local executable distribution; no hosted service or release pipeline is configured. A single initial SQLite migration is embedded from migrations/sqlite and applied on database open. It creates seven application tables for the catalog, whole-workout sessions, performances, sets, preferences, identities and credentials on fresh databases; previous incremental migration files were removed. Existing databases with the old migration history require separate handling and are not automatically reset. New migration filenames are generated with the golang-migrate CLI using the real clock. The database uses foreign keys, WAL mode, a 5000 ms busy timeout, and a single open connection. Supported release platforms, packaging, and rollback procedures are not yet specified.
